newsitem.title: USA: Republicans holding own in early House races - TV.
newsitem.headline: Republicans holding own in early House races - TV.

text.p: Republicans seemed to be holding their own in their battle to retain control of the House of Representatives, according to preliminary results and exit polling on Tuesday.
Both the NBC and ABC networks said the early results so far showed no change in the balance of power in the House, where Republicans held a 235-197 majority.
ABC said so far neither party had made any net gain in seats. It said Democrats had won 133 seats and Republicans 149. Thirty Republican freshman had won re-election and two had lost.
NBC stressed that the House outcome was still too close to call.
In contrast, in the Senate, Republicans looked poised to retain control.
